reviews.title: Quiet pump and great cooling
reviews.comment: Kept my CPU temps nice and low even under load. The RGB looks great and the pump is surprisingly quiet. Very easy to install for an AIO.
reviews.author: guZzy92fs

reviews.title: Quiet pump and fans
reviews.comment: Really quiet pump and fans.  Though, I do wish they come with spring tension screws to better securing the pump to the CPU bracket.
reviews.author: DD

reviews.title: Does not immediately fit am3+ without additional hardware.
reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing. Aside for the hardship I endured considering i needed a new mounting bracket to install to my am3+ gigabyte mobo. Thid is cooling my amd 8320 3.6ghz. Idle this thing stays at 16c and under load it maybe gets as high as 31c. Full 20 minutes tress test under sida64 extreme, this thing peaks at 31c. This thig is amaaaazing.
reviews.author: Destiny
